title: Nvidia invests $1B in Nokia

sources.quote: NVIDIA to invest USD 1.0 billion (EUR 0.86 billion) in new Nokia shares at a purchase price of USD 6.01 (EUR 5.16) per share
The share issue was completed on 13 November 2025 with NVIDIA becoming an approximately 2.90% shareholder of Nokia.

explain: Nvidia bought $1 billion of newly issued Nokia shares, about 2.9% of the company, alongside a partnership on AI-powered mobile networks and data center networking. Nokia said it would use the money to push into networking for AI.
